title: Lavender Clumping Cat Litter

details.description: Transform your litter box experience with Drools Clumping Lavender Litter, the perfect solution for multiple cats. Crafted with natural lavender oil, this clumping formula offers outstanding odour control and superior absorbency, keeping your home fresh and your feline friends happy. Designed to be 99% chemical and dust-free, this premium litter is processed from natural bentonite for a truly natural experience. Indulge your cat's senses with the soothing, calming aroma of lavender while enjoying the convenience of maximum clumping and absorption. Drools, the brand obsessed with pet wellbeing, has perfected this recipe to provide your pets with wholesome, mouth-watering nutrition. Transform your litter routine with Drools Clumping Lavender Litter, the ultimate solution for a clean, fresh, and odour-free home.
details.usageInstructions:
Step 1 - Place a layer of litter approximately 2 to 3 inches in the clean litter box
Step 2 - The litter will quickly form clumps, absorbing all the moisture from the box. Remove the clumps and clean the solid waste daily
Step 3 - Refill the litter box to maintain the 2-3 inches level of the litter
Step 4 - Dispose of used litter in the trash only
